title: Shopify Dev MCP validation evidence
description: Structured, verifiable evidence that a shopify-developer validation was performed through the plugin-scoped Shopify Dev MCP tools. Field names use what the Claude Code runtime actually provides (session id; the tool_use event id, e.g. 'toolu_...'; the tool name); the server's learn_shopify_api returns the conversationId. Nothing here is developer prose — the checker recomputes file hashes and matches the reviewed commit.

commit_sha.description: The exact commit the validation ran against; the checker rejects a mismatch with the reviewed build (stale/reused evidence).

executor.description: Executor identity or Claude Code session identifier.

gate.description: A local gate result must record the command, its exit code, and a REFERENCE (output_ref) to the captured output file plus its SHA-256. The checker recomputes the file hash and matches it — a typed status alone is not execution proof.

command.description: The exact command run; blank or no-op commands (true/false/:) are rejected by the checker.

output_ref.description: Relative path (inside the project root) to the captured output of this gate.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file at output_ref (verified by the checker).

record_ref.description: Reference to a structured MCP validation record (mcp-validation-record.schema.json) plus its SHA-256. Free-text is NOT accepted; the checker loads and schema-validates the record and binds its single event object's fields to this validation. This is a consistency-checked validation record, not an authenticated capture of a live Claude Code MCP call — that remains the mandatory interactive cold-session test.
Relative path (inside the project root) to the structured validation record (JSON).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the record file at record_ref (verified by the checker).

mcp_tool.description: Fully plugin-scoped MCP tool name; a bare or mis-scoped name fails this pattern.

tool_call_ref.description: The actual tool-call event identifier the runtime provides (the tool_use block id, e.g. 'toolu_...'), or a transcript event id.

conversation_id.description: The Shopify Dev MCP conversationId (returned by learn_shopify_api) when present.
